_comment: The Mednafen base the SE patch (apply.py) is built on. install.py pins the clone to fork_base_commit; apply.py warns when the checkout's version differs; release SOURCE.txt is generated from this file. Change it deliberately, in the same commit as any fork bump (see Integration/Mednafen/README.md). An existing checkout is not moved by install.py --incremental; re-run install.py without it (or git checkout the commit) after changing the pin.
